Rita: Quick sync: 'Nova' pilot asks: tenant-level encryption, 99ms p95 target for lightweight prompts, and burst-to-100 QPS for 30s. Need cross-team gating & minimum launch checklist. Call out blockers?

Sam: Runtime: burst prewarm doable but needs hot-pool + fast cold-start path. Blocker: model swap API + reserved pod count. Perf tests in 10 days.

Hiro: Infra: we can carve a dedicated subnet + 3x GPUs for the pilot. Need SKU confirmation by Wed to reserve. NAT and peering rules require security review.

Lena: Security: tenant key wrapping via HSM required. Blocker until attestation & threat model approval. Shadow mode ok for initial perf testing. Also need RBAC mapping for tenant admins.

Priy: SRE: suggested SLOs: p95 < 120ms for lightweight prompts, error_rate < 0.4%. Canary ramp: 10% -> 40% -> 100% over 3 days. Need oncall for ramp and a rollback playbook.

Marco: Finance: extra GPUs + HSM add ~$10k/mo. If customer signs 3mo commitment we can subsidize half. Need product to confirm commitment ask.

Sam: Proposed minimal acceptance gate list:
- HSM attestation green
- infra reserved
- perf test p95 < 120ms at 10%
- runbook + oncall slots filled
- cost terms agreed
Owners: Rita, Sam, Hiro, Lena, Priy, Marco

Rita: Action items: Hiro reserve hardware by Wed, Lena publish attestation checklist by Tue, Sam run perf test in 10 days, Marco draft 3mo price by Thu, Priy prepare runbook draft. Can we commit?

Hiro: Will queue reservation; will post SKU & ETA by EOD Wed.

Lena: I'll draft the checklist and ping SecOps for attestation slot. Shadow perf allowed before attestation.

Sam: I'll instrument hot-pool and schedule perf run. Will post results here.

ops-bot: Note: "Deployment window tentative: 2026-05-01 03:00-05:00 UTC. Confirm approvals before scheduling."

Rita: OK team, I'll start the customer SOW asking for a 3mo commit to enable 10% initial canary. Flag any hard blockers now. :memo: :rocket:
